question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

Sunny turned to find his daughter's sweet, __bright__ eyes close to his.
solution:
The correct answer is "**dusky**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that means the opposite of the given word.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The given word is "bright", which means full of light or shining**.(चमकदार)
 
 
• Example: It is a bright and nice day. 
 
 
 
• **The word "dusky" means dim or dark. **(काला)
 
 
• ​Example: Her skin turned a dusky gold in the sun. 
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "dusky" is the antonym of the word "bright."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (gleaming) means shining or glowing brightly, which is a synonym of the given word.(चमचमाती)
 
• Option 2 (anxious) means worried or nervous, which is not related to the given word.(चिंतित)
 
• Option 4 (merry) means cheerful or happy, which is not related to the given word.(प्रमुदित)
